encoder: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5): a single agent working alone from BRIEF.md, with no subagents and no other encoding to copy from
display_name: Interpretation Act (British Columbia): a reusable time module, definitions and repeal, by a single Sonnet 5.5 agent
target_note: The brief mandates REFUSE; main build 98 rejects REFUSE, REFUSED, BECAUSE and YMD (dialects.md of the writing-l4-rules skill). The brief does not name a target, so unstable is an inference. No run against a main build was made.

scope.encoded: Every provision with a condition a function can compute: s 1 (regulation, enactment), 2(1), 3, 4, 5(1), 14, 16(2), 18, 20(3)-(4), 24, 25 to 25.5 (the counting of periods of days, weeks, months and years, the holiday and closed-office rules), 25.1, 26, 28(1), 29 (commencement, now, month, year, holiday, deliver, mail, minor), 32, 33(1), 35, 36(1)(a), (d), (e), 38, 42(2). Holidays are an input to the caller's function; Sunday and 26 December come from `s 29 a day is a holiday`.
scope.not_encoded: The canons of construction and the provisions with no condition to compute are inert, each with a reason in the coverage table of NOTES.md (ss 6 to 13, 15, 17, 19, 21 to 23, 27, 29.1, 29.2, 30, 31, 34, 37, 39 to 41, 43, 44, the Schedule, and the rest of s 29). Four sub-provisions are repealed in the text. The Regulations Act, which governs the commencement of a regulation that is not exempt, is not in the text.

not_reviewed: No domain expert has read this encoding against the statute. It was written from a script-made plain-text rendering of the King's Printer consolidation (current to 2026-10-13), which is not the official text; nothing is verified against the official text. The tests were decided from that rendering by the encoder who wrote the code.

expected_red.why: Rival readings of the text, written as expectations that are meant to fail; see the header of that file and NOTES.md section 2.

checks.note: check.sh with the pinned binary and target unstable: 376 assertions satisfied, 16 failed by design (expected_red), 0 refused, 0 other errors. No run against a main build. NOTES.md section 4 has the exact output.
